title: Pretends to be a relative with a new number
why: The 'Hi Mum, this is my new number' message copies a real relative to ask for urgent money. Call the person on their old number before sending anything.
examples: Hi Mum, I lost my phone, this is my new number. Please send Rs 15,000 urgently on GPay.
Hello papa this is my new number, need money transfer for an emergency.
safe: I changed my number, please save the new one for future.
